messages:
cory_sales: Heads-up — Acme POC just hit a spike of 5xxs during the scripted ramp. Demo on call and theyre asking about SLA. Can ops triage fast?

li_se: Which route/model and any sample request ids? Load profile?

cory_sales: Route `acme-poc-main`, model `redwood-primexl`. Ramp 15->130 RPS over 2m. IDs seen: ac-201, ac-202, ac-203.

anya_support: Edge logs: 
```
[2026-07-08T10:02:11Z] request_id=ac-201 response=502 reason="upstream_overloaded"
[2026-07-08T10:02:13Z] request_id=ac-202 response=503 reason="burstpool_queue_full"
[2026-07-08T10:02:40Z] request_id=ac-203 upstream_error: autoscaler_attach_failed: region_capacity"
```

sam_oncall: Autoscaler attempted two scale-outs at 10:02:12 and 10:02:32. Cloud returned capacity errors; attach retries exhausted and traffic spilled to shared-burstpool which hit max queue and started returning 503s.

li_se: Short-term mitigations: (1) set `soft_limit_rps=50`, (2) enable `fallback_model=redwood-primexl-quant`, (3) set `max_concurrency=1`, (4) enable `elastic_burst=true`. Medium: move POC to a dedicated-small reserved instance to avoid spot/quota problems.

cory_sales: Acme wants minimal demo quality loss. ETA for dedicated-small? Pricing delta?

sam_oncall: We can provision dedicated-small with expedited approval in ~4-6h (ticket CH-12077) or 24-48h normally. Cost ~+25% for the POC week; can offer one-time credit. Owner for CH-12077: @li_se.

anya_support: I can patch route now and collect full logs: patch will reduce errors but serve some requests from quant fallback. Also will log a credit for the deal.

infra-bot: Applying patch to route `acme-poc-main`: {soft_limit_rps=50, fallback_model=redwood-primexl-quant, max_concurrency=1, elastic_burst=true} (patch-id: patch-9993).

infra-bot: Patch applied. Monitoring: 5xx rate fell ~18% -> ~3% within 45s. Quant fallback handled a portion of requests.

li_se: Opening CH-12077 to request reserved capacity in-region. I'll push for expedited allocation.

cory_sales: I'll tell Acme: (A) immediate mitigation applied, (B) one-time credit for POC instability, (C) proposal to move to dedicated-small with SLA. Also asking if Private deployment needed to avoid shared burstpool — any notes?

sam_oncall: Private (VPC/dedicated nodes) is available but requires legal & infra lead time (~2-3 weeks). For short-term, dedicated-small solves capacity.

anya_support: Logs and incident summary uploaded to the Deal record. Credit logged and approved for demo.

cory_sales: Owners recap: mitigation/logs (anya_support), capacity ticket CH-12077 (li_se), compliance notes (sam_oncall), sales credit + proposal (cory_sales). Joining the call now to present this.

li_se: If new 5xxs show up after the patch, paste request ids here and Ill escalate attach retries and force failover to reserved pool.

cory_sales: Thanks team — updating Acme now. :thumbsup:
